domain-information: A Member signs up for a new membership to access the gym.
A Member can access and view their membership record.
A Member books a fitness class to join a scheduled session.
A Member submits a request to freeze their membership for a short period.
A Member book a personal training session with a trainer.
A Front Desk Staff processes a sign up and creates a new membership record for a member.
A Front Desk Staff updates a member's details when personal information changes.
A Front Desk Staff forwards a member complaint to the facility manager for follow-up.
A Front Desk Staff member receives a clients request to pause their membership and processes it.
A Trainer schedules a new fitness class to add it to the weekly timetable.
A Trainer reviews class attendance to adjust future class capacity.
A Trainer provides personalized workout plans to help members reach their goals.
A Trainer logs the performance of a member in their membership record.
A Facility Manager inspects gym equipment to determine what needs maintenance.
A Facility Manager submits a repair order to fix broken machines.
A Facility Manager updates the status of equipment.

domain objects.name: Member
domain objects.description: Person who holds a gym membership and uses gym services.

domain objects.name: Membership Record
domain objects.description: Stored information about a member’s membership status and history.

domain objects.name: Sign Up
domain objects.description: Action and data submitted to start a new membership.

domain objects.name: Fitness Class
domain objects.description: A scheduled group training session offered by the gym.

domain objects.name: Attendance
domain objects.description: Count of members who attend a fitness class.

domain objects.name: Capacity
domain objects.description: Maximum number of members allowed in a fitness class.

domain objects.name: Pause Request
domain objects.description: Member’s request to temporarily freeze their membership.

domain objects.name: Front Desk Staff
domain objects.description: Staff responsible for membership handling and customer requests.

domain objects.name: Member Complaint
domain objects.description: A complaint submitted by a member about gym issues.

domain objects.name: Trainer
domain objects.description: Gym professional who conducts classes and personal training.

domain objects.name: Weekly Timetable
domain objects.description: List of all scheduled fitness classes for the week.

domain objects.name: Workout Plan
domain objects.description: A personalized training plan created by a trainer.

domain objects.name: Personal Training Session
domain objects.description: An individual training appointment between a trainer and a member.

domain objects.name: Facility Manager
domain objects.description: Staff responsible for equipment maintenance and facilities.

domain objects.name: Gym Equipment
domain objects.description: Exercise machines and equipment available in the gym.

domain objects.name: Status
domain objects.description: Current condition or usability state of equipment.

domain objects.name: Repair Order
domain objects.description: Request issued to repair malfunctioning gym equipment.

associations.description: Front Desk Staff processes Sign Up.
Front Desk Staff creates or updates Membership Record.
Front Desk Staff handles Pause Request.
Front Desk Staff records Member Complaint.
Member Complaint is forwarded to Facility Manager.
Trainer schedules or updates Fitness Class.
Trainer adds classes to Weekly Timetable.
Workout Plan is provided to Member.
